verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents selectable data scopes, product-scoped consents, or data-minimization controls. The Data API and consent mentions describe what data is available and that users give consent, but not that a developer can limit a request to only the scopes it needs. Missing for 10: documented per-scope consent requests and documented data-minimization controls.

support.subject: As a developer, I request only the data scopes I need — product-scoped consents and documented data-minimization controls, not an all-or-nothing grant
